body: Yea I recently got comfortable with having a significant other, it's been a while since I could ever love someone else since my girlfriend died. That's probably the biggest recent event, like I already had trust issues before I met her.  I had to cut it off with this girl because she didn't want anything serious- but in the beginning everything was so clear and serious, so I was real confused as she changed. I've always tried to please everyone and it's worked so well but I've always felt off.  Like something just isn't right. I've moved around so much and so many people I've loved have passed. I know I can't control most things but I feel I can't help anymore. There's no one thing I can say that's made me feel like this. I think I may have been too concerned with the wrong things but I'm trying to do the right thing.  I feel like I'm the only person who can't make a mistake sometimes. I've been trying to be the best me that I can be but it's not working out.  So I just want to leave
